The studio at Upside Living is available from end of June, so a 3-month stay works timing-wise. We don't have a video for this one, but the photos are on the listing: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-upside-living-2PSudOeqYWO.html

If you need more space than a studio, a 1-bedroom would be the next step up. Want me to check what 1-beds we have available around that time?
